units.source_text: 那幽静娴雅的音调，非常肖似伊势的六条妃子。

en.t: That quiet and refined tone of voice closely resembled the Rokujō lady of Ise.

units.source_text: 她正在无心无思、随意不拘的时候，源氏公子突然走进内室，使她感到非常狼狈。

en.t: Just when she was sitting there thoughtlessly and at ease, Prince Genji suddenly entered the inner room, leaving her terribly flustered.

units.source_text: 她便从附近的一扇门里逃进更里面的房间里，不知怎么一来，把门紧闭了。

en.t: She fled through a nearby door into a still deeper room and, somehow or other, shut the door tight.

units.source_text: 源氏公子并不用力推门。

en.t: Prince Genji did not try to force the door open.
But how could such a situation last for long?

units.source_text: 不久自然与小姐直接会面了。

en.t: Before long, he naturally came face to face with the young lady herself.

units.source_text: 但见这位小姐仪容高雅，体态苗条，令人一见倾心。

en.t: He saw that the young lady had an elegant bearing and a slender figure, enough to captivate him at first sight.

units.source_text: 这段意外因缘，源氏公子本不敢希望其成就。

en.t: Prince Genji had never dared hope that this unexpected bond would come to fruition.

units.source_text: 今日居然能成事实，便觉此人格外可爱。

en.t: Now that it had actually become real, he found her all the more dear.

units.source_text: 大概他对于女人，一经接近，爱情便会油然而生吧。

en.t: Perhaps, with women, once he drew near, affection would simply well up of its own accord.

units.source_text: 平日每恨长夜如年，今日只觉秋宵苦短。

en.t: Ordinarily he resented long nights that seemed to last for years, but tonight he felt only that the autumn night was painfully short.

units.source_text: 但深恐外人得知，不免有所顾忌，便对她立下山盟海誓，于黎明前匆匆退出。

en.t: Yet, deeply afraid that others might find out and unable to avoid some caution, he swore solemn vows to her and hurried away before dawn.
